subject: general
question: A newly discovered bright green viper snake species found in the forests of ________ has been named after Salazar Slytherin.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A group of researchers have recorded a new serpent and named it** Salazar’s pit viper.**
 
• The new species, Trimeresurus Salazar is the fifth variety of reptiles to have been discovered in **Arunachal Pradesh** in a little more than a year.
 
• The name was inspired by** Salazar Slytherin**, the co-founder of **J.K. Rowlings’ fictional Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Arunachal Pradesh:**

 
 
• **State Animal **- Gayal.
 
• **State Bird **- Great Hornbill.
 
• **National Parks** - Mouling National Park, Namdapha National Park.
 
• **Dams** - Dibang Dam (Dibang River), Ranganadi Dam (Ranganadi River), Subansiri Lower Dam (Subansiri River).
